svg.title: Morris Family · Substance Use Pattern
svg.desc: Three Morris generations show alcohol-use, opioid-use, and depression fills, Arthur’s deceased cross, and Caleb’s index outline. Curved gutter ties distinguish Caleb–Peter cutoff, Caleb–Susan closeness, and Peter–Susan conflict, with the no-contact label in the cutoff break. Arthur and Joan are parents of Peter and Linda; Peter and Susan are parents of Caleb and Emily. Arthur has alcohol use disorder and depression; Peter has alcohol use disorder; Caleb has opioid use disorder.
